en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a tree‑lined street with multi‑story residential or commercial buildings on the left and fenced front gardens. A person walks along the largely empty street. Overhead utility poles line the road. At the top right in red print it says "Freiberg i. Sa. Weissbachstrasse." On the left ground‑floor facade a shop sign reads "Julius Ihle." The scene appears to depict Weissbachstrasse in Freiberg.
